mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_id, uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) card_name, ps.current_spend_amount, MIN(r.previous_spend_min_krw) required_spend_amount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN user_notification_settings ns ON ns.user_id=uc.user_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id=uc.card_id INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.content_version_id=cv.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers o ON o.benefit_id=cb.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules r ON r.offer_id=o.offer_id INNER JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots ps ON ps.user_card_id=uc.user_card_id AND ps.performance_month=#{performanceMonth} WHERE uc.is_active=TRUE AND ns.performance_closing_enabled=TRUE AND r.previous_spend_min_krw IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id=cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at>cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at=cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id>cv.content_version_id))) GROUP BY uc.user_id,uc.user_card_id,cv.name,uc.card_name_from_codef,ps.current_spend_amount HAVING current_spend_amount < required_spend_amount

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM notification_history WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND user_device_id=#{deviceId} AND notification_type=#{type} AND ((reference_id=#{referenceId}) OR (reference_id IS NULL AND #{referenceId} IS NULL)) AND notification_date=#{date} AND ((time_slot=#{timeSlot}) OR (time_slot IS NULL AND #{timeSlot} IS NULL)) AND status='SENT')
